body:
A consolidated **bounded dev3 acceptance proposal** is ready for investigator review. Preparing it was authorized; its scientific disposition is **not yet accepted**. #8 remains open/partial, and D40 retains its original twelve-input dev0 scope.

Maintained report: `devguide/hydramp_dev3_acceptance_review.md`,
SHA-256 `8a0e340b90fcf8f17c5a2e49b63498851672a0720801bdfd55e5c3a5a7b932ad`.
Evidence manifest: `devguide/evidence/hydramp_dev3_acceptance_review.json`,
SHA-256 `2fbfddeb009b5b058be055b6ded8ad3a1e9173cd5fc3fe5a47efe03a19a454f8`.
The manifest preserves 17 source receipts, eight source reports and the exact adapter plan. No model/PCA/descriptor/Macrel call or scientific-array deserialization was performed for this review.

**Recommendation:** accept the exact local `hydramp-torch==0.0.0.dev3` bundle as an experimental PeptideMT resource for the commissioned seeded, unfiltered AMP route, with all recorded limitations preserved. Provider wheel SHA-256 remains `81761e0d48d92f0956e0afc28b3b4154f16032de53c666fd2cfbb53606102ed7`; consumer remains `18b1cb18b9662092203aad9c64d45bc0d61a862577297c13a664572dbdbc3e83`.

Evidence supporting the recommendation:
- All 256 distinct latent inputs / 6,400 distinct-input token positions agree between original and modern implementations; all 7,700 paired positions including controls agree. Actual batches retain sequence/order/occurrence views and five descriptors.
- Full AMP-head FP64 comparison on the selected 192-row diagnostic cohort favors modern aggregate error; individual outputs favor modern 91, original 58, equal 43. Genuine original advantages and error compensation remain explicit; no universal pointwise superiority is claimed.
- The separately approved real installed public adapter case returns 16 proposals with exact retained modern rows/order/indices/full trace, exact saved replay and seven-record captured parent attribution. Whole-case observation: 8.358 s / 432.2 MiB sampled aggregate tree RSS.
- Private H4 composition retains 32 proposals, assesses 30 compatible strings and reproduces both selectors after replay.

Material limitations and conditions:
- Preserve probability and global AMP-ranking **FAILs**, original thresholds and all measured values. Ten global pair changes can alter AMP-only top-k membership. The current PeptideMT selectors use Macrel AMP/hemolysis, with no new HydrAMP-score prefilter.
- Nine of thirty assessable generated strings are Macrel AMP-positive, all also Hemo-positive; **zero joint AMP-positive/NonHemo hits**. This is a finite computational observation, not biological efficacy or a general failure-rate estimate. Two leading-M exclusions remain visible.
- H4 was a private source-extension experiment; the public adapter generation case is separately installed-qualified. A single all-public live generation→Macrel→selection workflow was not rerun.
- Starter-versus-original-Drive asset byte identity is still unverified. Existing exact assets, local-research use conditions, original notices and attribution remain the boundary; no broader redistribution/output-use clearance follows.
- No changed weights, precision, chemistry, selectors, families, training, analogue/target-conditioned route, feedback, GPU or release. All execution allowances remain consumed; acceptance would not itself authorize further calls.

If investigators accept or narrow the proposal, record their exact disposition before changing acceptance labels. Then prepare the workflow tutorial using retained receipts first. A scientific utility benchmark needs its own prospective design and commissioning. The precision proposal and provider metadata issue remain independently owned work.

Report navigation and the existing #8 work record are synchronized. Ruff, formatting, report indexes, whitespace, all 27 recorded source stamps and 213 relative file links pass. These are documentation/evidence checks; earlier scientific runs and controlled tests are reused with their original scope. No accepted decision, commit, push or package/model publication was created.
